assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

The live DeepSeek Harness recording passes all five lifecycle phases and all transcript and observation assertions. The same DSH session follows ready -> working -> waiting -> working -> ready. The transcript contains one successful exit_plan_mode call and one successful Bash edit after approval.

`TotalTokens` is the latest usage snapshot. In this recording it is 12743, from the last assistant message. The three measured assistant contributions are 13008, 12685, and 12743. Their sum is 38436. The replay cumulative fields are input=38005 and output=431, also 38436. The expected observation `cumulative_tokens_equals: 38436` verifies this cumulative contract. The command in expected.jsonl derives the three message totals from the committed transcript.

This scenario does not change global TotalTokens semantics. The current scenario text distinguishes latest-snapshot TotalTokens from cumulative input and output.
caveats: The state arc alone is insufficient. Transcript assertions require plan activation, a successful exit_plan_mode call, a successful Bash editor call, and model-attributed messages.
TotalTokens remains the latest snapshot, 12743. The cumulative contract is 38436, from 13008 + 12685 + 12743 and replay cumulative input 38005 plus output 431.
The committed expected.jsonl contains the zstdcat and jq command that derives 38436 from the recording transcript.
The scenario assertion checks cumulative input plus output. It does not change the global TotalTokens contract.
The active TUI profile must compose @deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode and @deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions. The local qwen/qwen3.5-9b model and danger-full-access policy are recipe preconditions.

sources.note: Official package reference: /plan enters plan mode; exit_plan_mode presents the plan for Approve or Keep planning; approval continues into execution.
Installed 0.1.5-rc.2 implementation registers exit_plan_mode, orders Approve first, returns approved:true, and schedules mode exit for the next accepted step.
The installed TUI plan-review overlay starts with cursor 0 and submits the selected option on Enter.
appendToolCall writes tool/call before prepare and dispatch; appendToolResult runs only after execution completes.
The DSH source tails compressed v3 transcripts through FilesUnderRoot.
The parser maps tool call/result records, turn boundaries, model identity, token snapshots, and per-message contributions.
The canonical user-blocking matcher includes the exact DSH tool spelling exit_plan_mode.
An open user-blocking tool maps working to waiting; later activity and agent completion recover working and ready.
Each PerTurnContribution is added to the per-model cumulative token accumulator.
The assessed sibling establishes the same DSH plan-review entry path; this cell continues past approval into implementation.
The driver implements slash, sleep, keys, and transcript-backed wait_turn and pins the local qwen recording surface.
Three assistant/message usage pairs are 12706/302, 12596/89, and 12703/40, all model qwen/qwen3.5-9b.
Summary reports cum_input_tokens=38005, cum_output_tokens=431, total_tokens=12743, and flicker_count=0.
Test explicitly asserts TotalTokens means the latest turn's token snapshot, not cumulative usage.
Verifier checks only nonzero cumulative tokens or nonzero TotalTokens; it cannot assert sum equality.
ObservationSpec has nonzero token assertions but no cumulative TotalTokens equality assertion.

assessment.historical_body: Historical catalog mismatch: the earlier scenario text required TotalTokens to accumulate all message contributions. The established product metric is the latest snapshot, so the scenario now checks the separate cumulative input-plus-output contract.

preconditions: dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 or newer is on PATH and the community TUI profile is installed under the active DSH home
the active TUI profile composes @deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode and @deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions; re-probe with `dsh --profile tui --dump-config` at record time
LM Studio is serving the tool-capable qwen/qwen3.5-9b model through http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1; re-probe the live model list at record time
DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access maps to sandbox danger-full-access and approval policy never in the active profile
irrlichd is recording with DeepSeek Harness transcript permission granted
setup: Create an empty cwd under the recording staging directory.
Let the driver apply the LM Studio endpoint, model, and danger-full-access policy through its per-run environment and temporary patch.
Send the full /plan task as one driver turn so wait_turn expects and observes one completed durable boundary.
Confirm that the TUI plan review still lists Approve first. The keys step relies on the installed overlay's default cursor at option 0.

script.text:
/plan Do not read files, search, write, or call any tool except exit_plan_mode before approval. Immediately call exit_plan_mode as your first and only pre-approval tool call. Use this exact Markdown as the plan argument: # Architect editor fixture

After approval, call bash exactly once with command `printf %s approved-editor > architect-editor.txt` and description `Create approved editor fixture`. Then reply with exactly `done`. Do not send prose before the exit_plan_mode call.

verify: events.jsonl shows the real session-UUID row born ready, then ready -> working when the /plan message starts
events.jsonl shows the same session move working -> waiting while the exit_plan_mode review is open
events.jsonl shows the same session move waiting -> working after Enter approves the plan and the implementation step starts
events.jsonl shows the same session move working -> ready after the completed turn/end, with final state ready

the compressed transcript contains one active plan/mode record, one successful exit_plan_mode call/result pair, one inactive plan/mode record, and then one successful bash call/result pair whose arguments target architect-editor.txt
the cwd contains architect-editor.txt with exact content approved-editor after the turn
at least two assistant/message records in the same turn carry model qwen/qwen3.5-9b and non-zero usage; TotalTokens is the latest snapshot (12743), while cumulative contributions equal 38436
the transcript contains no approval/asked record and no tool call other than exit_plan_mode and bash
recipe.scope_note: The first staged run sent bare /plan before a separate task message. Its complete transcript contained plan/mode active and one prose answer, but no exit_plan_mode call. The recorded DeepSeek Harness 2.18 sibling sent /plan with its task in one command and produced the tool call. This recipe now sends that same command shape through send, which increments the expected durable turn count so wait_turn observes the completed implementation boundary. The 240-second pre-approval hold matches the recorded 2.18 recipe. The 20-second trailing settle matches the recorded Claude Code sibling. The observed recording passes the lifecycle, transcript, and cumulative contribution assertion. TotalTokens remains the latest snapshot, while cumulative input plus output equals 38436.
